title: 第3章 菜刀在手天下我有第4章 师姐也怕迷魂阵
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
流年似水，山中无岁月，五年时光转瞬而逝。
溪水边一块平坦的巨石上，一紫裙女孩眼睛微闭，正端坐在蒲团之上，周身萦绕着一层淡淡的光晕。
她精致的五官仿佛被精心雕琢过，十岁左右的年龄竟给人一种冰冷艳丽的感觉。
“师妹，今天不是你负责看管小师弟吗？他怎么又跑出去了……”
一绿裙女孩飘然而至，眉眼如画。
年龄也在十岁左右。
“我布置了阵法，他怎么可能跑出去？”
紫裙女孩睁开眼，一脸疑惑。
“地下面你忘布置了吧，他挖了个地洞跑出去了。
咱俩快点去追，要不他又惹祸了。”
“这小赖皮，前几天把我的七彩莲花给祸害了，莲蓬和莲子都给吃了，莲藕都没放过。
这回抓住了，一定狠狠打屁股！
师姐，你不准拦着。”
“嗯，我和你一起打！
我的伏魔果也被他偷吃了。
你说气人不，伏魔果那么硬，他一口气吃了好几个。”
“嗯，他牙口真好，就是一个吃货。
啥东西被他看上了，一定弄嘴里。”
“咱们看上的东西一定看管好了，以后要布置上阵法，要不防不住他。”
“哼，师尊就惯着他，也不管管。

这回师尊不在，咱俩狠狠揍他！”
两个小女孩正是清婉和紫嫣。
师尊闭关，她俩负责照看落尘。
看管一个月，落尘偷偷跑出去三十天。
弄得方圆几百里，鹰飞虎跳，兽心惶惶。
密林中一片平缓的草地上，一汪碧潭点缀其间。
潭边，落尘骑在一只烈焰狮子上，小小的身材和巨大的狮子同框，画面极不协调。
他下身皮靴短裤，上身只穿一个红肚兜。
捆在腰间的绳索上别着一把硕大的菜刀。
手里拎着一根紫藤做的长鞭。
他胯下的烈焰狮是性格最暴躁的妖兽之一，此时却无比温顺。
落尘的面前，站着金刚猿、飞天豹、幽冥狼、三尾狐等各类妖兽，黑压压的一片，数量上千。
每只妖兽都低眉顺眼，恭恭敬敬的，大气都不敢出。
“金刚猿，老大要训话了，你怎么敢站得比老大还高？”
一只三尾狐口吐人言，挥动前爪指指点点。
几只两丈多高的金刚猿吓得一哆嗦，赶忙蜷缩身体。
content_en:
Time flies like water, and there is no time in the mountains. Five years have passed by in a blink of an eye.
On a flat boulder by the stream, a girl in a purple skirt had her eyes slightly closed and was sitting on a futon, with a faint halo surrounding her body.
Her delicate facial features seemed to have been carefully carved, and she gave people a cold and gorgeous feeling even though she was about ten years old.
"Junior sister, weren't you responsible for taking care of your junior brother today? Why did he run out again..."
A girl in a green dress floated over, with picturesque features.
He is also about ten years old.
"I set up the formation, how could he escape?"
The girl in the purple skirt opened her eyes with a confused look on her face.
"You forgot to arrange it underground, he dug a hole and ran out.
Let's hurry up and chase him, or he'll get into trouble again. "
"This little scoundrel caused trouble to my colorful lotus flowers a few days ago. He ate all the lotus pods and seeds, and even the lotus roots were not spared.
If you catch me this time, you will be spanked hard!
Senior sister, you are not allowed to stop me. "
"Well, I'll fight with you!
He also stole my demon-suppressing fruit.
You said it was irritating, but the Demon-Suppressing Fruits were so hard that he ate several of them in one go. "
“Well, he has really good teeth and is a foodie.
Whatever caught his eye, he would definitely put it in his mouth. "
"We must take good care of what we are interested in. We must arrange the formation in the future, otherwise we will not be able to guard against him."
"Humph, Master just indulges him and doesn't care about him.
This time the master is not here, let’s beat him hard! "
The two little girls are Qingwan and Ziyan.
The master is in seclusion, and they are responsible for taking care of Luochen.
After one month of guarding, Luochen sneaked out for thirty days.
It caused eagles to fly and tigers to jump within a radius of hundreds of miles, and the beasts were in panic.
On a gentle grassland in the dense forest, there are green pools dotted in it.
Beside the pool, Luochen is riding on a flaming lion. His small body is in the same frame as the huge lion. The picture is extremely incongruous.
He was wearing leather boots and shorts, and only a red bellyband on his upper body.
There was a huge kitchen knife attached to the rope tied around his waist.
He was holding a long whip made of wisteria in his hand.
The flaming lion under his crotch is one of the most violent monsters, but at this moment it is extremely docile.
In front of Luochen, stood a variety of monsters such as a diamond ape, a flying leopard, a ghost wolf, a three-tailed fox, and so on. They were all dark and numbered in the thousands.
Every demonic beast lowered their eyebrows and looked respectful, not daring to express their anger.
"King Kong Ape, the boss is about to lecture you, how dare you stand taller than the boss?"
A three-tailed fox spoke human words, waving its front paws and pointing.
Several two-foot-tall diamond apes shivered in fright and hurriedly curled up.
